notes: Fixed a crash in the new snapshot-capture code (5.2.0): a case's priority field can be an int, not a string, and calling .upper() on it silently killed every snapshot capture ('int' object has no attribute 'upper', caught and logged but never actually saving data). Also fixed the same 'unlabeled fleet-wide finding' bug class as the IMT interop message fix in two more places: the EOL-imminent tool warning in runIMTInteropCheck() now names the affected system(s) instead of zero attribution, and the MetroCluster Infrastructure Health tiles (Mediator/MAUSO/Known Bugs) now show which specific system triggered each flag instead of one merged fleet-wide tile. Also cleared a stale 'wl_prod' placeholder watchlist ID left over from before multi-account setup that was showing up as a phantom entry in the sidebar.
